  cardMarketContent = '## Multiverse of Madness: Scarlet Witch Dominance

Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022) was significant for card collectors because of Elizabeth Olsen''s Scarlet Witch becoming the film''s true star and villain. Sam Raimi''s horror-influenced direction also brought a unique visual style.

### Key Sets

The **2022 Upper Deck Multiverse of Madness** set features Elizabeth Olsen, Benedict Cumberbatch, Patrick Stewart (Professor X cameo), and Xochitl Gomez''s debut.

### Market Trends

Elizabeth Olsen (Scarlet Witch) autograph cards are the clear winners — she dominates the film and WandaVision made her one of the MCU''s most popular characters. Patrick Stewart''s Professor X cameo cards carry massive X-Men crossover appeal.',
  keyCards = '- **Elizabeth Olsen as Scarlet Witch Auto** — MCU''s most powerful ($5,000+)
- **Patrick Stewart as Professor X Auto** — X-Men MCU crossover ($4,000+)
- **Benedict Cumberbatch Doctor Strange Auto** — Sorcerer Supreme ($3,000+)
- **Xochitl Gomez as America Chavez Debut Auto** — New hero ($800+)
- **Illuminati Insert Set** — Multiverse council cards
- **Zombie Strange Variant Cards** — Horror-themed chase cards',
  content = '## The Multiverse of Madness

Sam Raimi brought his signature horror style to the MCU, creating the franchise''s darkest and most visually inventive film. Elizabeth Olsen''s Scarlet Witch is the true star — a grief-stricken mother willing to destroy the multiverse to reunite with her children. It''s a bold, divisive film that pushed MCU boundaries.

## The Legacy

- **Sam Raimi Returns** — The Spider-Man trilogy director brought genuine horror to the MCU
- **Scarlet Witch** — Elizabeth Olsen delivered the MCU''s most terrifying villain performance
- **The Illuminati** — Introduced the multiverse council including Professor X, Mr. Fantastic, and Captain Carter
- **America Chavez** — Xochitl Gomez debuted as the multiverse-hopping hero
- **Horror MCU** — The film''s PG-13 horror pushed the boundaries of what MCU films could be

## Fun Facts

- Sam Raimi replaced Scott Derrickson as director, bringing his Evil Dead horror sensibility
- Patrick Stewart''s Professor X appearance was the first official X-Men/MCU crossover
- John Krasinski played Mr. Fantastic in the Illuminati scene, though his future in the role is uncertain
- The film contains the MCU''s most graphic deaths, including multiple Illuminati members
- Elizabeth Olsen''s performance was widely praised even by critics who disliked the film

## Viewing Context

Multiverse of Madness requires watching **WandaVision** (Disney+) to understand Wanda''s motivation and **Spider-Man: No Way Home** for multiverse context. It directly follows both. The Illuminati scene references the wider Marvel multiverse including X-Men and the Fantastic Four.',

It was directed by Sam Raimi and features Elizabeth Olsen as the Scarlet Witch."},{"question":"Do I need to watch WandaVision first?","answer":"Yes — WandaVision is essential viewing before Multiverse of Madness. Wanda''s entire motivation stems from the events of that Disney+ series and her grief over losing Vision and her children."},{"question":"What Multiverse of Madness cards are valuable?","answer":"Elizabeth Olsen Scarlet Witch autos ($5,000+) dominate the set. Patrick Stewart Professor X autos ($4,000+) carry X-Men crossover appeal. Benedict Cumberbatch autos ($3,000+) are strong Sorcerer Supreme cards."},{"question":"Is Professor X in this movie?","answer":"Yes — Patrick Stewart appears as Professor X in the Illuminati scene, marking the first official X-Men/MCU crossover.
